items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: David Raksin could do it, probably still can, he’s just joined the board of ASCAP

ctx.x: And his uses of woodwinds of course.

Yeah. There aren’t many who can write that sensually, one of the great sensual writers was Alex North, in some of his film scores. David Raksin could do it, probably still can, he’s just joined the board of ASCAP [American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers] and boy are we glad to have him.
I remember in the early 50s Miles said in print that he was raving about Alex North his, Streetcar Named Desire score he said that was something everybody should hear.
